definitions.explanation: The hours when the sun is up, as opposed to night.

examples.english: I like daytime more than nighttime. Because I can play outside.

notes:
{昼|ひる} has two meanings: noon/midday specifically, and daytime generally.

COMPOUNDS:
- {昼|ひる}⟦ごはん→ごはん：00776_gohan⟧/⟦{昼食|ちゅうしょく}→昼食：01616_chuushoku⟧: lunch
- ⟦{昼休|ひるやす}み→昼休み：01715_hiruyasumi⟧: lunch break
- ⟦{昼間|ひるま}→昼間：01713_hiruma⟧: daytime
- ⟦{昼寝|ひるね}→昼寝：00106_hirune⟧: nap
- ⟦{昼過|ひるす}ぎ→昼過ぎ：12966_hirusugi⟧: early afternoon

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {昼|ひる}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: at noon
- {昼|ひる}⟦ごろ→頃：00932_goro⟧: around noon
- {昼|ひる}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧: day and night

TIME PROGRESSION:
⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧ (morning) → {昼|ひる} (noon/daytime) → ⟦{夕方|ゆうがた}→夕方：01010_yuugata⟧ (evening) → ⟦{夜|よる}→夜：00487_yoru⟧ (night)
